'''Makem Te spaceport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]]. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="Scourge" /> [[New Ambition|''Shadowfire'']],<ref name="Tempest Feud">''[[Tempest Feud]]''</ref> a [[Suwantek Systems|Suwantek]] [[TL-1200 transport]] owned by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Popara Anjiliac Diresto]] docked at [[landing pad X-13]] at the spaceport. The [[Jedi archivist/Legends|Jedi archivist]] [[Mander Zuma]] and the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] [[Reen Irana]] and [[Eddey Be'ray]] were granted use of the ship for a mission to the planet [[Endregaad]] and they departed the spaceport aboard the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]].<ref name="Scourge" />
